name: Microwave Oat Porridge
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Mix water, oat flakes, and salt in a bowl.
Boil on high heat for 2–3 minutes.

culture.text: Porridge is a type of semi-solid food made by soaking, poaching or boiling, in milk or water, ground, crushed or chopped starchy plants, typically grain. It is a traditional staple food of many countries.
